readmeMarkdown:
# Senta ХАБЭА Plugin for Antigravity

Official **Antigravity** plugin connecting your agent to **Senta (ХАБЭА / HSE)** via Senta's unified remote MCP gateway (`https://control.senta.mn/mcp`).

Works for **both** organization members (permits, observations, inspections, instructions, safe drafts) and **standalone users without an organization** (Mongolian HSE laws, `MNS 4969:2000` training standard, `ХАБЭА-н сургалтын журам`, `MNS 5140:2026` official document formatting standard, and HSE document templates).

---

## Install

### Global (all workspaces)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/cia-mn/senta-antigravity-plugin ~/.gemini/config/plugins/senta
```

### Project-scoped (single workspace)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/cia-mn/senta-antigravity-plugin .agents/plugins/senta
```

Antigravity automatically discovers the plugin. Open **Additional Options (`...`) → MCP Servers** (or the **Senta ХАБЭА** plugin page in Customizations) to complete the Senta OAuth 2.1 SMS sign-in.

To update later:
```bash
git -C ~/.gemini/config/plugins/senta pull
```

---

## What's Included

- **MCP Server (`mcp_config.json`):** Remote Streamable HTTP endpoint `https://control.senta.mn/mcp`
- **Skill (`skills/senta-hse/SKILL.md`):** Guided workflows for HSE/training standards, `list_organizations`, all 14 read-only HSE tools, and 3 safe non-signing write tools
- **Rules (`rules/AGENTS.md`):** Always-on MNS 4969:2000 compliance rules, `org_id` scoping, PII masking expectations, and Mongolian/UTC+8 date formatting
- **Logo & Starter Prompts (`plugin.json`, `assets/logo.png`)**

---

## Managing Organization Access & Revocation

You control per-organization MCP access live at **[https://app.v2.senta.mn/account](https://app.v2.senta.mn/account)** → **AI / MCP хандалт**:

- **Хаалттай (`off`)** — blocks organization tools immediately (HSE standards remain available)
- **Зөвхөн унших (`read`)** — default; 14 read-only organization tools
- **Унших + Ноорог (`write`)** — adds `create_safety_observation`, `add_observation_comment`, and `create_instruction_draft` (`publish: false`)
- **Revoke anytime** under **Холбогдсон AI апп ба төхөөрөмжүүд**

> **Compliance (MNS 4969:2000):** Phone and national register/passport numbers are masked automatically. Legal signatures (briefings, permits, waivers), approvals, and destructive deletes are never performed over MCP.
